**Read at source (objectui `origin/main`).** The console app's page passes an `errorMessages` map (`apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx:168`, with `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` at `:177`). The exported page passes none, so `RegisterForm` falls back to `authError.message`: the server's English text, and for `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` an internal setting name.

**Why p2.** It is objectui#10998's class (p2), on the exported page that `examples/console-starter` mounts. Every locale sees raw English, and one message leaks an internal term.

**Direction (triage's call on the claimant's open choice): one map, not two copies.**
- The two pages drifted because each carried its own. Put the refusal-code map in `@object-ui/app-shell` once, keyed on the pack keys PR objectui#11029 added: `auth.register.errors.userExists`, `.selfRegistrationClosed` and `.emailDomainNotAllowed`. Have both pages pass it. ⛔ No second hand-written copy.
- The unknown-code fallback stays as it is.
- `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` stays unmapped on purpose (operator-facing), as the card says.
- **Pins:** the exported page under zh-CN, for each of the three codes, plus the unknown-code fallback, as PR objectui#11029's test does for the console page.
